item.name: Leprechaun II
item.notes: Also appears in the Super Enchant Stone premium pool at equal 20% odds with four other top rolls.
item.cardSummary: Flat +50% luck for every session. One of the best general rolls from Enchant Stones, and a common Super Stone target.

item.name: Empowered I
item.notes: Hybrid luck and reel buff. Available in both the normal 14-pool and Super Stone five-pool.
item.cardSummary: Splits value between luck and faster reels. Strong all-rounder when you want more than pure luck alone.

item.name: Leprechaun I
item.notes: Normal Enchant Stone only. Not in the Super Stone five-pool.
item.cardSummary: A solid flat luck boost and one of the more common Enchant Stone rolls. Fine to keep until Leprechaun II or another S-tier lands.

item.name: Mutation Hunter III
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Not Super Enchant Stone. Evolved stones are fished in Ancient Ruin after Sacred Temple unlocks.
item.cardSummary: Highest dedicated mutation chance among named Hunter tiers. Only available from Evolved Enchant Stone rolls at Ancient Ruin.

item.name: Mutation Hunter II
item.notes: Also listed in Evolved pool tables as a shared outcome. Super Stone raises the pull rate to 20%.
item.cardSummary: Strong mutation farming buff from the standard and Super pools. Prefer this over Mutation Hunter I when mutation value is the goal.

item.name: Cursed I
item.notes: High-risk hybrid. Super Stone can force it into the five-name premium pool.
item.cardSummary: Trades a large luck penalty for a large mutation boost. Best when mutation payouts matter more than rare base fish, or when a second slot can offset the luck loss.

item.name: Gold Digger I
item.effect: +10% chance to apply the Gold mutation.
item.notes: Normal Enchant Stone only for the Super five-pool; still appears on some Evolved pool tables as a shared outcome.
item.cardSummary: Pushes catches toward the Gold mutation specifically. Useful when gold variants pay more than generic mutations.

item.name: Mutation Hunter I
item.notes: Common normal-pool roll. Not in the Super Stone five-pool.
item.cardSummary: Entry-level mutation boost from Enchant Stones. Keep only if you lack better mutation rolls.

item.name: Fairy Hunter I
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Not Super Enchant Stone.
item.cardSummary: Specialized Fairy Dust mutation boost only from Evolved Enchant Stone at Ancient Ruin.

item.name: Glistening I
item.notes: Collector-focused shiny boost. Not in the Super Stone five-pool.
item.cardSummary: Raises shiny fish odds without a broad mutation or luck package. Niche compared with flat luck or Mutation Hunter rolls.

item.name: Perfection
item.effect: Guarantees Perfect casts while fishing (second enchant slot).
item.notes: 5% pull on Transcended Stone. Get the stone by sacrificing a Secret-rarity fish to the Temple Guardian at the top of Sacred Temple. Does not come from Enchant or Super stones.
item.cardSummary: Second-slot exclusive that locks Perfect casts. Unlocked through Transcended Stone at the Sacred Temple double-enchant altar.

item.name: Prismatic I
item.effect: Rainbow boost activates after fewer casts.
item.notes: Sources disagree on the exact cast reduction (reported as 8 or 10 fewer throws). Effect confirmed; exact number left unstated.
item.cardSummary: Speeds up Rainbow boost activation by reducing the casts required. Available from normal and Super Enchant Stones at Esoteric Depths.

item.name: Big Hunter I
item.notes: Size increase can raise sell value on size-scaled fish. Normal Enchant Stone only.
item.cardSummary: Increases fish size by 10%, which can improve payouts when size affects value. Simple utility roll from Enchant Stones.

item.name: XPerienced I
item.notes: Same math as a 50% XP bonus. Best while leveling islands and features; weaker once XP is no longer the bottleneck.
item.cardSummary: Boosts XP on every catch. Strong leveling pick early, then usually replaced by luck or mutation enchants.

item.name: Reeler II
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Stronger reel bonus than Reeler I.
item.cardSummary: Faster reels from the Evolved pool only. Use when you want pure reel speed without luck or mutation tradeoffs.

item.name: Reeler I
item.notes: Modest speed-only buff. Often outclassed by luck, mutation, or hybrid rolls.
item.cardSummary: Small reel-speed increase from Enchant Stones. Usually a reroll candidate unless you specifically want faster reeling.

item.name: Stormhunter II
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Only helps while rain weather is active.
item.cardSummary: Huge rain-only luck boost from Evolved Enchant Stone. Save for rainy sessions or a weather-focused second rod.

item.name: Stargazer II
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Only helps during nighttime.
item.cardSummary: Night-only luck boost from Evolved Enchant Stone. Strong for dedicated night farms, weak in daytime.

item.name: Stormhunter I
item.notes: Weather-gated luck. Normal Enchant Stone only.
item.cardSummary: Strong luck only while it rains. Keep on a rain rod or reroll if you fish mostly in clear weather.

item.name: Stargazer I
item.notes: Time-gated luck. Sometimes paired as a second-slot offset for Cursed I in community guides.
item.cardSummary: Night-only luck boost from Enchant Stones. Useful for night sessions, weaker as an all-day main enchant.

item.name: SECRET Hunter
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Not Super Enchant Stone. Name casing follows in-game SECRET rarity style.
item.cardSummary: Endgame SECRET-target enchant from Evolved Enchant Stone only. Prioritize for secret collection grinds after Ancient Ruin access.

item.name: Shark Hunter
item.notes: Evolved Enchant Stone exclusive. Not Super Enchant Stone.
item.cardSummary: Raises Shark catch odds from Evolved Enchant Stone rolls. Specialized endgame hunter for shark farming.
